title: Steinstraße, Leipzig
description:
Fully furnished single room (Studio apartment) in a well preserved 'Altbau' building. The apartment is 37 square meters as well as heaving a storage room for any suitcases etc. This ground floor apartment which is sitting higher then the street level (mezzanine floor), therefor enjoying privacy from the street. The bright apartment has a high celling and with 4 large windows going to the hight of the celling which allow a lot of light to enter the apartment- but still allow privacy. You find here: The living room and bedroom has a large wardrobe, a dining table, sofa and double bed with 1.60 m width. In the kitchen you will enjoy a fitted kitchen with fridge, microwave, stove and basic equipment of crockery and pots. In the white tiled bathroom you will have a bathtub and a washing machine

The apartment is located in a quiet side street of the popular Karl-Liebknecht-Straße , a perfect entertainment street with many bars, restaurants and shops spread along the street. Supermarkets are also waling distance away. On Karl-Liebknecht-Straße you can hop on tram line 10 & 11 end connect to the rest of the city to the university, to the old city centre and to shops and shopping centres

title: Alfred-Kästner-Straße, Leipzig
description:
Elegant Mezzanine-Level Altbau Studio with High Ceilings
Experience refined living in this elegantly furnished studio apartment set within a beautifully preserved Altbau building. Offering 31 m2 of thoughtfully designed space, the apartment also includes a separate storage room—ideal for luggage and personal items.

Situated on an elevated ground floor (mezzanine level), the residence benefits from both convenience and privacy. Impressive high ceilings and two grand, floor-to-ceiling windows illuminate the interior with soft natural light while maintaining a discreet atmosphere.

The main living and sleeping area is tastefully appointed with a wardrobe, dining table, comfortable sofa, and a 1.60 m double bed, creating a harmonious balance of comfort and style.
The well-equipped kitchen features a fitted kitchen unit with refrigerator, oven, and essential cookware, while the bright, white-tiled bathroom includes a shower and a private washing machine for added convenience.

Location:
Nestled on a peaceful side street just steps from the vibrant Karl-Liebknecht-Straße, the apartment combines calm residential charm with immediate access to one of the city’s most sought-after boulevards. Here you’ll find an array of cafés, restaurants, boutique shops, and daily amenities, including nearby supermarkets. Tram lines 10 and 11 are only moments away, providing excellent connections to the university, the historic city center, and major shopping districts.

title: Berliner Straße, Leipzig
description:
Das Apartment zeichnet sich neben deinem eigenen Balkon durch einen weitläufigen Wohn- und Arbeitsraum aus. Genieße unvergleichliche Freiräume in unserem größten und luxuriösesten Apartment. Ein Handgriff reicht aus, um den Raum zu verwandeln: Das modulare Bett klappt nach oben, verschwindet in der Wand und offenbart einen gemütlichen Wohnbereich mit Couch. Alle Apartments überzeugen mit einladender Atmosphäre, einem gemütlichen Ambiente und überdurchschnittlichem Komfort dank durchdachter Einrichtungsdetails. Die moderne Ausstattung mit High-Speed WLAN und Internet, Flat-Screen TV, Espressomaschine, Kühlschrank u.v.m. lässt keine Wünsche offen.

Ort
Das Apartmenthaus verfügt über zahlreiche kostenlose Fahrradstellplätze. Unser Reinigungsservice sorgt zweiwöchentlich für eine saubere Wohnatmosphäre. Zusätzlich ist ein Handtuch-Service inklusive. Im Zuge der Reservierung kannst du weitere extra Services bequem hinzubuchen, beispielsweise einen PKW-Stellplatz oder eine wöchentliche Reinigung. Zudem findest du im Apartmenthaus Waschmöglichkeiten, sowie einen Gemeinschaftsbereich mit einer Küche zur freien Nutzung.

Ausstattung
Die neu errichteten Apartmenthäuser in Leipzig zeichnen sich durch ihre zeitgemäße Architektur, eine außergewöhnliche Flexibilität und ein Höchstmaß an Wohnkomfort aus. Seit Ende 2022 befinden sich an diesem Standort insgesamt 83 Longstay-Apartments - mit einem Fokus auf Design, Digitalisierung und Automatisierung. Wir verbinden das temporäre großstädtische Wohnen mit einem großen Augenmerk auf Privatsphäre und Bequemlichkeit. Sie bieten Rückzugsmöglichkeiten als auch Kontakt zur urbanen Community von Leipzig. Unser Reinigungsservice sorgt zweiwöchentlich für eine saubere Wohnatmosphäre.

Welcome to your temporary home in Leipzig! This newly renovated and stylishly furnished 2-room apartment (63 m2), located on the border of Plagwitz and Lindenau in the popular western part of the city, offers everything you need for a comfortable and hassle-free stay – perfect for expats, temporary professionals, or international students.

- 63 m2 of living space on the 2nd floor (no elevator)

Highlights:
- Small park directly across the street – great for relaxing
- Shops for daily needs (supermarket, pharmacy, drugstore, etc.) within walking distance
- Excellent public transport connection: tram lines 8 and 11 take you directly to the main station, with stops on Karl-Heine-Straße

Location – Between Plagwitz & Lindenau:
This apartment is located right where two of Leipzig’s most vibrant neighborhoods meet: Plagwitz and Lindenau, part of the lively West Leipzig area.

Plagwitz is known as the creative heart of the city – former industrial buildings now house art studios, start-ups, galleries, and co-working spaces. The nearby Karl-Heine-Straße is a cultural hotspot full of cafés, bars, restaurants, and local shops.

Lindenau, just around the corner, has a slightly quieter charm with green spaces, local markets, and a relaxed atmosphere. It’s popular with young families, creatives, and international newcomers.
